notes.title: Latest Fixes
notes.content:
Thank you for your feedback so far, we apologise for any inconvenience caused by bugs. As such we have updated the game to try and fix any of the issues raised.

- The tutorial level has been relocated and renamed to become more visible to the player. 

- Disabled the ability to resize the game window in an attempt to minimise UI issues.
